Full job description

ALOHA Collection is a fast growing lifestyle brand that was born out of a love of travel, adventure and the ocean. This California based brand with Hawaiian roots located in Encinitas, CA focuses on travel accessories. Travel is our inspiration, the beach is our home.


ROLE OVERVIEW

The Data Analyst will provide data driven recommendations to support the operations and growth of ALOHA Collection. This role will be responsible for collaborating with internal partners and unlocking reporting and analysis capabilities for each team. Day-to-day work will consist of addressing data related queries from stakeholders by creating data products such as dashboards, reports, analysis, and automation. This role offers the flexibility of being hybrid (Carlsbad, CA) or fully remote.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Query and analyze data using SQL to track marketing KPIs and assess business health, using AI tools to accelerate query writing, exploration, and pattern-finding.
Design, develop, and continuously improve impactful and dynamic reporting and visualizations — including interactive dashboards and AI-generated artifacts — that provide clear, actionable insights into product performance, operational efficiency, and company trends.
Support and help enforce data governance standards — including consistent metric definitions, naming conventions, access, and documentation — so teams work from reliable, well-understood data and decisions are built to scale as the business grows.
Own regular data sweeps and audits, ensuring records are accurate, complete, and consistent, and partnering with relevant teams to resolve discrepancies at the source.
Apply strong judgment to validate and quality-check AI-assisted analysis and outputs, ensuring accuracy and sound interpretation before insights are shared or acted on.
Act as a Subject Matter Expert, providing training and ongoing guidance to teams using data and AI tools to make decisions.
Champion AI adoption across the organization: identify high-value use cases, build and share reusable prompts, workflows, and artifacts, and coach teams on effective, responsible use.
Lead and manage ad-hoc reporting requests and analysis, using AI to increase speed and depth of turnaround.
Implement and support continuous improvement in data analytics, business intelligence, and reporting efficiency and effectiveness, including integrating AI and automation into recurring workflows.

EXPERIENCE WE'RE LOOKING FOR

2+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or related field
Experience in retail or E-commerce industries a must
Strong proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools (e.g., Omni, PowerBI, etc.)
Experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or similar) to accelerate analysis, reporting, and problem-solving — with the judgment to validate outputs for accuracy before relying on them
Expert level in Google Sheets

WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE TABLE

Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to present complex data in a clear and concise manner to all levels of the organization
Strong analytical skills including attention to detail and independent problem solving
A natural curiosity and intuition for data — ability to create models/frameworks to break down complex problems without fully defined requirements and questions
Enthusiasm for helping others adopt data tools; comfort coaching and enabling non-technical teammates

WHAT WE OFFER

From the start, our founders, Heather and Rachael, envisioned a company culture that was dynamic, intentional and sustainable. We provide education about Hawaiian culture and opportunities for personal and professional growth for every member of Team ALOHA. We believe in work-life balance and trust, which is why we offer flexible remote working options and show up with compassion when life's unexpected moments arise. And if you haven't heard, we LOVE working together!
